data.narrative:
Nara Space Technology is a publicly listed Space & Aerospace company founded by Park Jae-pil, having raised KRW 33.5B (~$25M) to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage public peers: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The 4-company comparable set yields a median valuation of $5.2B, with a range spanning $840M at the low end to $40.0B at the high end. This 48x spread reflects meaningful heterogeneity within the public space technology sector—driven by differences in operational maturity, launch cadence, and market positioning. A public-comp anchoring approach using the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 27.4x could not be applied, as Nara's revenue figures are not on file.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4.4B (low) to $6.0B (high), centered on the peer median of $5.2B. Key uncertainties include the exact revenue scale and profitability trajectory of Nara relative to the comparable set, as well as the company's specific position within the fragmented commercial space ecosystem. The wide dispersion in peer valuations underscores that stage and sector alone are insufficient valuation anchors; operational differentiation and growth visibility materially drive multiples in this sector.
